title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #3

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is the most famous sacred river in Hindu teaching? (1 mark)
   A. Ganga
   B. Athi
   C. Nzoia
   D. Tana

2. Which faith honours the Bodhi tree most because of the Buddha? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Jainism
   D. Islam

3. Why can children with special needs join the tree planting activity? (1 mark)
   A. Only adults can plant
   B. They must not be included
   C. They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   D. They are too weak

4. Which element is called Agni? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Fire
   C. Air
   D. Space

5. Which medical use of Tulsi is mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A cloth
   B. A fuel for cars
   C. Tea for coughs and colds
   D. A tool for digging

6. At what time of day did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. At midnight
   B. At sunrise
   C. At noon
   D. In the evening, between day and night

7. What does Asteya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fast all day
   B. Do not take what is not given
   C. Sing every day
   D. Sit still

8. In which city was Guru Ram Das Ji born? (1 mark)
   A. Lumbini
   B. Lahore
   C. Varanasi
   D. Nairobi

9. Which of these is one of Parshvanath's four rules? (1 mark)
   A. Satya, always speak the truth
   B. Wealth at any cost
   C. Be proud
   D. Take what you like

10. In which script is Guru Granth Sahib Ji written? (1 mark)
   A. Gurmukhi
   B. Arabic
   C. Roman
   D. Swahili script

11. Who first compiled Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   B. Valmiki
   C. Mahavir
   D. Guru Ram Das Ji

12. How can you learn more about scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Keep them in a bag
   B. Listen to a resource person or visit a library
   C. Ignore them
   D. Copy them from memory only

13. Who took Ram and Lakshman to protect his forest prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Sage Valmiki
   B. King Shibi
   C. Guru Nanak
   D. Sage Vishwamitra

14. What does Dainik mean? (1 mark)
   A. Weekly
   B. Monthly
   C. Daily
   D. Yearly

15. What could you use to map the Mandirs in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. A safe digital map with a teacher's help
   B. A dream
   C. A random guess
   D. A song

16. What is the shikhara? (1 mark)
   A. The bell
   B. The floor
   C. The kitchen
   D. The spire above the inner room

17. What should you do before taking photographs in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Ask permission
   B. Take at once
   C. Photograph the murti closely
   D. Use flash

18. From which Veda does the Gayatri Mantra come? (1 mark)
   A. Rig Veda
   B. Atharva Veda only
   C. Dhammapada
   D. Ramayan

19. What is aarti? (1 mark)
   A. Eating
   B. Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
   C. Painting
   D. Reading a map

20. What is the murti in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. A lamp
   B. A seat
   C. A book
   D. A statue of God

21. What does dravinam mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Knowledge
   C. Mother
   D. Prayer

22. What should passengers do before boarding a vehicle? (1 mark)
   A. Run alongside it
   B. Push others
   C. Jump onto it
   D. Wait for the vehicle to stop

23. Which is honest behaviour with technology? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing your personal details with strangers
   B. Sending unkind messages
   C. Asking permission before using a device
   D. Copying someone's work

24. What is a common mistake about lies? (1 mark)
   A. Owning up
   B. Thinking small lies do not matter
   C. Thinking honesty is important
   D. Returning items

25. How do you show integrity in a test? (1 mark)
   A. Do your own work
   B. Copy from a neighbour
   C. Whisper answers
   D. Look in your bag

26. Which is safe behaviour in a matatu? (1 mark)
   A. Standing in the aisle
   B. Putting the head out of the window
   C. Distracting the driver
   D. Wearing the seat belt

27. You find Ksh 100 on the school field. What shows integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   B. Give it away
   C. Keep it quietly
   D. Spend it on sweets

28. What does Kirat Karni mean? (1 mark)
   A. Painting
   B. Travelling
   C. Fasting
   D. Earning by honest work

29. What does the story of Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo teach? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating pays
   B. Honest earnings are best
   C. Wealth is proof of goodness
   D. Rich people are wrong

30. What should you do if you find an item left on the vehicle? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it
   B. Throw it away
   C. Give it to the driver or conductor
   D. Give it away

31. What is Bhastrika called in English? (1 mark)
   A. The hare pose
   B. The shining forehead breath
   C. The bellows breath
   D. The moon pose

32. What does asana mean? (1 mark)
   A. A posture or seat
   B. A prayer
   C. A river
   D. A song

33. Which pose is called the hare or moon pose? (1 mark)
   A. Bhastrika
   B. Sasankasana
   C. Vajra Asana
   D. Kapaal Bhaati

34. What does Kama mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. War
   C. Cruelty
   D. Good and healthy wishes such as joy and friendship

35. What does Paramatma mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Supreme Soul
   B. A holy river
   C. A festival
   D. A daily prayer

36. What does charity work at festivals help with? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing with those who cannot afford food or clothes
   B. Buying more sweets for ourselves
   C. Wasting food
   D. Making noise

37. Which mistake is common about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Knowing about fasting
   B. Knowing it is in Phalguna
   C. Thinking it is the same as Diwali
   D. Knowing it is for Shiva

38. Which teaching of Paryushan do children practise when they forgive a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Anger
   C. Forgiveness
   D. Revenge

39. What is the Panchang? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A kind of tree
   C. A prayer
   D. The Indian traditional calendar book

40. Which is the largest planet in the solar system? (1 mark)
   A. Jupiter
   B. Mercury
   C. Venus
   D. Mars

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Describe Bharat's action after he returned to Ayodhya. (3 marks)

42. Explain how the four faiths in this lesson teach integrity. (5 marks)

43. Write a short paragraph on why honesty is the best policy. (5 marks)

44. Describe the story of Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo and its lesson. (4 marks)

45. Give three safety measures to observe during festivals. (3 marks)

46. What is a rite or ritual? Give one example. (2 marks)

47. Why should we not pollute rivers? (2 marks)

48. State three ways of showing respect to the National flag and Anthem. (3 marks)

49. What does Prani Daya mean? (2 marks)

50. Name two parts of a Mandir. (2 marks)

51. State four ways of caring for plants and water. (4 marks)

52. Explain how you would present a short skit on one Enlightened Being. (4 marks)

53. Name two trees or plants that are sacred in different faiths. (2 marks)

54. State three contributions of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji. (3 marks)

55. Explain how a person shows integrity when handling money. (3 marks)

56. Describe the story of King Shibi and the dove and give its lesson. (4 marks)

57. Give three ways of showing respect to any scripture. (3 marks)

58. Name the four Enlightened Beings studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

59. What is an asana? (2 marks)

60. Why is Saraswati shown with a veena and a book? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Ganga
   The Ganga in India is honoured by many Hindus.

2. A — Buddhism
   The Buddha became enlightened under a Bodhi tree.

3. C — They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

4. B — Fire
   Agni means fire, heat and light.

5. C — Tea for coughs and colds
   Tulsi leaves are used in home medicine such as tea.

6. D — In the evening, between day and night
   It was neither day nor night but the time between.

7. B — Do not take what is not given
   Asteya means not stealing.

8. B — Lahore
   He was born in Lahore.

9. A — Satya, always speak the truth
   Satya means truthfulness.

10. A — Gurmukhi
   It is written in Gurmukhi.

11. A — Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   Guru Arjan Dev Ji was the fifth Guru.

12. B — Listen to a resource person or visit a library
   We can listen, read and discuss.

13. D — Sage Vishwamitra
   Vishwamitra asked for their help.

14. C — Daily
   Dainik means daily.

15. A — A safe digital map with a teacher's help
   We can use a map on a tablet.

16. D — The spire above the inner room
   It is the spire or dome.

17. A — Ask permission
   Always ask first.

18. A — Rig Veda
   The Gayatri Mantra comes from the Rig Veda.

19. B — Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
   It is a prayer with a lamp.

20. D — A statue of God
   The murti is a statue or image of God.

21. A — Wealth
   Dravinam means wealth.

22. D — Wait for the vehicle to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

23. C — Asking permission before using a device
   Permission is part of responsible use.

24. B — Thinking small lies do not matter
   Small lies grow.

25. A — Do your own work
   Doing your own work is honest.

26. D — Wearing the seat belt
   A seat belt protects you.

27. A — Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   A lost note belongs to its owner.

28. D — Earning by honest work
   Kirat Karni is honest labour.

29. B — Honest earnings are best
   Honest work is valued.

30. C — Give it to the driver or conductor
   Returning it shows integrity.

31. C — The bellows breath
   A bellows pumps air into a fire.

32. A — A posture or seat
   An asana is a posture.

33. B — Sasankasana
   Sasankasana.

34. D — Good and healthy wishes such as joy and friendship
   Kama is good and healthy desire.

35. A — The Supreme Soul
   It is the highest soul, God.

36. A — Sharing with those who cannot afford food or clothes
   We share with the needy.

37. C — Thinking it is the same as Diwali
   They are different festivals.

38. C — Forgiveness
   Paryushan teaches saying sorry and forgiving.

39. D — The Indian traditional calendar book
   It lists days, months and festival dates.

40. A — Jupiter
   Jupiter is the biggest.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused the throne, went to ask Ram to return, took Ram's sandals and placed them on the throne, and ruled as a humble servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hinduism: truth (Harishchandra). Sikhism: honest earnings (Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo). Jainism: not stealing (Asteya). Buddhism: right speech and not stealing or lying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each faith and 1 mark for a summary.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: An honest person is trusted, feels calm, makes friends, keeps a good name and helps the community. A liar loses trust. Examples such as returning lost money or not cheating support the paragraph.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the topic, 2 marks for reasons, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for a clear conclusion.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guru Nanak chose to eat at the home of Bhai Lalo, an honest carpenter, instead of Malik Bhago's feast. The lesson is that honest work is the best way to earn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Bhai Lalo, 1 mark for choosing his home, 1 mark for honest labour, 1 mark for the lesson.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Adults light lamps, stay with adults in crowds, wash hands before eating, use bins, walk and do not run (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: A special action done in a set way at a festival, such as lighting a lamp or raising a flag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Polluted rivers harm plants, animals and people who use the water, and take away the sacredness of the water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stand straight, be quiet, never let the flag touch the ground, learn and sing the anthem (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kindness to all living beings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for kindness and living beings.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Entrance, main hall, inner room (garbhagriha), spire (shikhara), bell (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant a tree or Tulsi, water plants early or late in the day, collect rainwater, close taps and mend leaks, and never throw plastic into rivers (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a story, decide the characters, practise the lines, act it out, and then say what lesson it teaches.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for choosing the story, roles, practice, acting and lesson (any four).

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tulsi, Ber (Beri) tree, Bodhi tree, Sal tree (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plant.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: He started the city of Amritsar and the Sarovar, composed hymns and the Laavan, and taught equality and service.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each contribution.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Returns extra change, pays for what he takes, brings back the correct change and does not borrow secretly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: A frightened dove flew into the king's lap and a hawk demanded it. The king offered his own flesh to save the dove. The lesson is that a kind person protects the weak.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dove, 1 mark for the hawk, 1 mark for the offer, 1 mark for the lesson.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, keep it in a high place, wash hands before touching it, listen quietly, follow its teachings (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha, Parshvanath, Buddha (Prince Siddhartha) and Sri Guru Ram Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: A body posture.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for posture or seat.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: The veena stands for music and the arts and the book stands for knowledge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
